evidence:
Source comparison of every launch assumption in frozen tests/test.sh (byte-identical to template rules/projects/webdev-task-template/tests/test.sh per diff) against the brief and its notes:
(1) Entry: test.sh:68 refuses grading without /app/server.js and test.sh:111 runs node "$APP_ENTRY" (/app/server.js or the writable copy /tmp/submission/server.js, test.sh:97-102). Told: instruction.md:15 "It must start with node /app/server.js"; integration.md:5 "The process starts from /app/server.js"; hireops_rules.md:204-206 (sec 8) "may launch a writable copy of the submitted application. Resolve bundled UI and seed files relative to the entry or module directory".
(2) Port/probe URL: test.sh:48 and the restart helper test.sh:136 probe http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/health then /; test.sh:108 PORT=3000. Told: instruction.md:15 "listen on port 3000 (honour PORT if it's set), expose GET /api/health as a check that never touches the database"; integration.md:5-6,9-10 "listens on port 3000 on 0.0.0.0", "GET /api/health answers before database work can block startup". The ~30 s readiness window (120 x 0.25 s) is covered by the early-health requirement.
(3) Env vars: test.sh:104-109 env -i with PATH, NODE_PATH, HOME, PORT, DB_PATH (same set in helper test.sh:160-165). Told: hireops_rules.md:207-208 "The launch environment contains PATH, HOME, NODE_PATH, PORT and DB_PATH; do not rely on inherited shell variables."; NODE_PATH in integration.md:3-4.
(4) Storage: test.sh:98/101/109 DB_PATH=/app/app.db or /tmp/submission/app.db. Told: instruction.md:15 "keep its durable data in /app/app.db, honouring DB_PATH when that is set"; integration.md:7-8; rules sec 8 "Honor the supplied DB_PATH". Restart over the same DB (helper reuses __APP_DB__ and __APP_ENTRY__): integration.md:8-9 "Restarting the process over the same database file keeps all data, and seeding never duplicates records"; instruction.md:17 "keep new work across restarts".
(5) Seed/paths: verifier is environment_mode="separate" (task.toml:28); test.sh only chmods /assets (test.sh:88) and never relies on it for the app. Told: instruction.md:17 "Copy what you need into /app; /assets and /instructions are unavailable at runtime ... start with no shipped database". Golden reads its seed from src/seed_data.json via __dirname (solution/app/src/db.js:10), consistent.
(6) Privilege/cwd: setpriv --reuid=65534 (test.sh:110), chown of /app (test.sh:87), launched from the /tests WORKDIR. Told: rules sec 8 "may launch Node from a working directory other than the application directory. It runs as an unprivileged user".
(7) Symlinks: test.sh:72-83 zero reward on any symlink outside /app/node_modules. Told: integration.md:16-19 (task-added paragraph, exactly matching the rule).
(8) Deps: tests/Dockerfile:16-22 installs express@5.1.0 and better-sqlite3@12.4.1 globally with NODE_PATH, node from node:22-bookworm-slim, matching environment/Dockerfile:1-12. Told: instruction.md:15 "Server dependencies are already available, so don't install packages"; integration.md:3-4 "Node 22 process with Express and better-sqlite3 already available through NODE_PATH; use only those packages and Node built-ins".
No same-origin assumption exists (public network; prompts only open http://localhost:3000). REWARDKIT_* checks (test.sh:63) are harness wiring, not agent obligations. Sign-in and accounts are stated (instruction.md:19), so the house-convention false positive does not arise.
Adversarial tries: (a) broken app that could pass this contract: an app answering health with 500 or ignoring DB_PATH still passes the liveness probe (any HTTP response counts, test.sh:51-52; the default DB path equals the injected DB_PATH) - a lenient liveness probe, not a contract mismatch; gates and functional criteria decide product correctness. (b) conforming alternative that could fail: an app resolving files from process.cwd(), reading /assets at runtime, relying on an inherited env var, writing outside /app, or linking global node_modules would fail at launch - each is explicitly warned against in the brief/notes above, so the failure is attributable to the submission. Binding 127.0.0.1 or 0.0.0.0 both satisfy the 127.0.0.1 probe.
Colderwater lessons checked for this row: lesson 1/12 (no hidden demands) - every launch fact has a public sentence, phrased as runtime facts rather than grader-only knowledge; lesson 13 (no public address) - all probes and prompt URLs are 127.0.0.1/localhost; lessons 15/16 (restart) - helper relaunch contract (same entry, env, DB) matches the stated restart-durability requirement; lesson 19 (golden launched like test.sh) - raw-evidence-index entries re-hashed: all 8 artifact hashes and all matching_source_files hashes match the frozen task; workspace.cjs:16 launches node /app/server.js with cwd /tmp and env limited to PATH/HOME/NODE_PATH/PORT/DB_PATH, as uid 65534 after a solve.sh install (via-solve.sh), with a real restart, and results/via-solve.log reports every group PASS including restart. That is a close emulation, not the literal test.sh/RewardKit run; the full configured verifier launch remains unmeasured but is owned by rows 21/22 and the runtime records and leaves no row-23 contract question open.
